ex.en: Don't write extra information, such as the name of the author, within the sentence.

ex.zh: 为了不错过火车，他匆匆赶往了车站。
ex.py: wèi le bù cuò guò huǒ chē， tā cōng cōng gǎn wǎng le chē zhàn。
ex.en: He hurried to the station so he wouldn't miss the train.

ex.zh: 除了下雨天以外，他每天都会走路上班。
ex.py: chú le xià yǔ tiān yǐ wài， tā měi tiān dū huì zǒu lù shàng bān。
ex.en: He goes to work on foot every day except on rainy days.

ex.zh: 叉子放在盘子的左边，刀子放在右边。
ex.py: chā zi fàng zài pán zi de zuǒ biān， dāo zi fàng zài yòu biān。
ex.en: Forks go to the left side of the plate, and knives go to the right.

ex.zh: 有些人认为从小学升到中学是踏入成年的第一步。
ex.py: yǒu xiē rén rèn wéi cóng xiǎo xué shēng dào zhōng xué shì tà rù chéng nián de dì yī bù。
ex.en: The graduation from elementary school to middle school is regarded by some as the first step towards adulthood.

en: to like; to be fond of; to take pleasure in; to be keen on

ex.zh: 对知识的爱好而言，我真的喜欢学汉字。
ex.py: duì zhī shí de ài hào ér yán， wǒ zhēn de xǐ huān xué hàn zì。
ex.en: In terms of intellectual hobbies, I really like learning Chinese characters.

ex.zh: 齐里跑出教室时撞到了人，摔倒在地。
ex.py: qí lǐ pǎo chū jiào shì shí zhuàng dào le rén， shuāi dǎo zài dì。
ex.en: As Ziri ran out of the classroom, he bumped into someone and fell to the floor.

en: nearly at the point of (doing sth); about to (do sth)

ex.zh: 我都快要说出他的名字了，可就是记不起来。
ex.py: wǒ dōu kuài yào shuō chū tā de míng zì le， kě jiù shì jì bù qǐ lái。
ex.en: His name was on the tip of my tongue, but I couldn't remember it.

ex.zh: 我们要六张门票，两张是学生票，这是我们的学生证。
ex.py: wǒ men yào liù zhāng mén piào， liǎng zhāng shì xué shēng piào， zhè shì wǒ men de xué shēng zhèng。
ex.en: We need six tickets, two of them are student tickets, here is our student identity card.

ex.zh: 你们学校真好，还帮你们报销来回的机票。
ex.py: nǐ men xué xiào zhēn hǎo， hái bāng nǐ men bào xiāo lái huí de jī piào。
ex.en: Your school is so kind to reimburse you for the return airfare.

ex.zh: 我把亚当的手表弄坏了，气得他七窍生烟。
ex.py: wǒ bǎ yà dāng de shǒu biǎo nòng huài le， qì dé tā qī qiào shēng yān。
ex.en: Adam was furious with me when I broke his watch.

en: to go abroad; to leave the country

ex.zh: 他的收入很高，所以每年都能出国旅行。
ex.py: tā de shōu rù hěn gāo， suǒ yǐ měi nián dōu néng chū guó lǚ xíng。
ex.en: His large income enables him to travel abroad every year.

ex.zh: 不管下不下雨，我都每天去公园跑步。
ex.py: bù guǎn xià bù xià yǔ， wǒ dōu měi tiān qù gōng yuán pǎo bù。
ex.en: Even when it rains, I go to the park every day to run.

ex.zh: 最近的药店在哪里？
ex.py: zuì jìn de yào diàn zài nǎ lǐ？
ex.en: Where's the nearest drugstore?

ex.zh: 明天天气不好，不是晴天，要下雪，很冷。
ex.py: míng tiān tiān qì bù hǎo， bú shì qíng tiān， yào xià xuě， hěn lěng。
ex.en: Tomorrow's weather won't be so good, with cloudy skies, heavy snow, and very cold temperatures.

ex.zh: 他找不到洗手间，只好向店员询问方向。
ex.py: tā zhǎo bú dào xǐ shǒu jiān， zhǐ hǎo xiàng diàn yuán xún wèn fāng xiàng。
ex.en: He couldn't find the restroom, so he had to ask the shopkeeper for directions.

en: foundation of a University or College
the start of a new term

ex.zh: 开学了，目前感觉还不错。
ex.py: kāi xué le， mù qián gǎn jué hái bú cuò。
ex.en: School has started and I like it so far.

ex.zh: 我看见你和一个高个子男孩在一起。
ex.py: wǒ kàn jiàn nǐ hé yí gè gāo gè zi nán hái zài yì qǐ。
ex.en: I saw you with a tall boy.

ex.zh: 昨天我变成了神，但没意思，所以今天我变成了鬼。
ex.py: zuó tiān wǒ biàn chéng le shén， dàn méi yì si， suǒ yǐ jīn tiān wǒ biàn chéng le guǐ。
ex.en: Yesterday I became a god, but found that a bit boring, so today I became a devil.

ex.zh: 我的书包里有很多彩色笔，红的，蓝的，绿的，等等。
ex.py: wǒ de shū bāo lǐ yǒu hěn duō cǎi sè bǐ， hóng de， lán de， lǜ de， děng děng。
ex.en: Inside my backpack there are many colored pens, red ones, blue ones, green ones, etc.

en: Japanese-style self-published comic (esp. an erotic one), aka "dōjinshi"

ex.zh: 这本单词本子上记的1000个英语单词，七月份之前要全部背下来。
ex.py: zhè běn dān cí běn zi shàng jì de 1000 gè yīng yǔ dān cí， qī yuè fèn zhī qián yào quán bù bèi xià lái。
ex.en: There are 1,000 English words written down in this vocabulary book, and they all have to be memorized by July.

en: to celebrate the Chinese New Year

ex.zh: 在中国，提到过年，许多人想到的都是一家围在一起包饺子。
ex.py: zài zhōng guó， tí dào guò nián， xǔ duō rén xiǎng dào de dōu shì yī jiā wéi zài yì qǐ bāo jiǎo zi。
ex.en: If you mention New Year in China, the image that many people will think of is a family gathered around wrapping dumplings together.

en: (slang) (of a girl) seemingly innocent and charming but actually calculating and manipulative
a girl who has these qualities

ex.zh: 打车去车站只要20分钟哦。
ex.py: dǎ chē qù chē zhàn zhǐ yào 20 fēn zhōng ó。
ex.en: It's only twenty minutes to the station by taxi.

ex.zh: 很巧， 昨天在饭馆里碰到了我的教授。
ex.py: hěn qiǎo， zuó tiān zài fàn guǎn lǐ pèng dào le wǒ de jiào shòu。
ex.en: By chance, I met my professor at a restaurant last night.

ex.zh: 请送两份早餐过来。2号餐加两杯奶茶。
ex.py: qǐng sòng liǎng fèn zǎo cān guò lái 。2 hào cān jiā liǎng bēi nǎi chá。
ex.en: Bring two breakfasts, please. Number 2 on the menu, and two teas with milk.

ex.zh: 你可以选择红茶，咖啡或牛奶。
ex.py: nǐ kě yǐ xuǎn zé hóng chá， kā fēi huò niú nǎi。
ex.en: You have a choice of black tea, coffee, or milk.

ex.zh: 与乘公交车相比，我更喜欢乘火车。
ex.py: yǔ chéng gōng jiāo chē xiāng bǐ， wǒ gèng xǐ huān chéng huǒ chē。
ex.en: I prefer to take the train rather than the bus.
